Follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nkoturovic/charmer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
when preparing a pull request.

- [ ] Explained what changed and why.
- [ ] Listed tests run and their results (`python3 tools/test.py` or the relevant modules).
- [ ] Updated documentation where behaviour changed.
- [ ] Used Conventional Commit messages.
- [ ] Checked that no secrets or personal data are included.
